events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on clinic for all skill levels. Learn to handle skipping/lagging shifting, chain issues, rubbing brakes, and valve core problems. Cost is $30. No refunds. Rain or shine event. Dress in clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Bring trail tools/kit. Check in 4:30-5pm with drink token and snack provided. For women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test + tune with industry partner Cane Creek Components. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on downhill trails with rocks and roots. Ride the same loop and dial in suspension with experts. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Bring riding clothes, pack, snacks, and water. No e-bikes allowed. First 8 emails to register get a spot. For women 18 or older.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery [342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712]. Neither location allows e-bikes. Registration required through Eventbrite. For women 18 and older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing [25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231]. This location does not allow e-bikes. Registration required through Eventbrite. For women 18 and older.
